name: jobgraph
description: JobGraph — Intelligent Job Explorer. Explore jobs through the connections between skills, technologies, companies, and opportunities. Powered by CognoDB (graph database) and the official Neo4j JavaScript driver.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
